problems.source_says: For S1-O1 through S1-O4, ChatGLM availability and actual use are established during the instructional intervention, but the article never states whether AI was available or removed while the scored pre/post-test responses were produced. A post-test after the intervention does not by itself establish unassisted production. Neither with_ai nor after_ai can therefore be confirmed. The form correctly preserves this uncertainty with null values; this is an unresolved evidence gap under the requested explicit-support verdict rule, not evidence that those nulls should be replaced by a guessed classification.
problems.quote: After the experiment, a post-test with an open-ended question about creativity and the same scale were administered to compare the improvement in creativity and students’ internal psychological perceptions.
problems.locator: Methods, Procedures, Phases I-III; Measurements, Cognitive Tests for Creativity; Appendix A, Table A1; Appendix B, Table B1 and coding procedure. Publisher article text is the source of record; no local PDF or page numbers.

confirmed.statement: All four outcomes are scored on produced open-ended test responses by two researchers; they are not self-reports. Criterion 3 holds.
confirmed.locator: Methods, Measurements, Cognitive Tests for Creativity, scoring paragraph and following rater-agreement paragraph; Appendix B, Table B1 note.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 correctly codes fluency and category_count: each distinct relevant idea receives one point, summed for the student.
confirmed.locator: Methods, Measurements, Cognitive Tests for Creativity; Appendix B, Table B1, Fluency row; worked example, Fluency row.

confirmed.statement: S1-O2 correctly codes novelty and category_count: the student score counts infrequently generated ideas. Sample-relative rarity is used to score individual originality, not a diversity outcome across people.
confirmed.locator: Methods, Measurements, Cognitive Tests for Creativity; Appendix B, Table B1, Originality row and coding procedure.

confirmed.statement: S1-O3 correctly identifies elaboration and a manual count measure. The form accurately preserves the conflict between counting detailed responses and counting individual detail instances.

confirmed.statement: S1-O4 correctly codes flexibility and category_count: categories are counted within one student’s ideas, not across different people.

confirmed.statement: No additional qualifying outcome was found in the complete saved text. Perceived creativity and the other psychological measures are questionnaire self-reports; classroom project feedback has no reported creativity-score comparison.

summary: All four outcomes satisfy criterion 3, and their constructs, measures, analysis units and reported numbers are supported by the saved article text, subject to scoring ambiguities already recorded in the form. Under the requested explicit-support rule, the conclusion is refuted because test-time AI access is unstated, leaving question and AI-availability classification unresolved despite the form correctly retaining null values.
